steps.arguments:
{"inp":{"code":"# Cálculos para a recomendação EALT4 (2025-04-01)
price = 13.89
shares = 22500000
equity = 295589000.0
net_debt = 108038000.0
ebit = 92788000.0
lpa = 2.957378
vpa = 13.137289
indemnity = 17200000.0

market_cap = price * shares
EV = market_cap + net_debt
P_over_L = price / lpa
P_over_VP = price / vpa
EV_over_EBIT = EV / ebit

# Ajuste ex-indenização
per_share_indemnity = indemnity / shares
lpa_adj = lpa - per_share_indemnity
pe_target = 8 * lpa_adj
pvpa_target = vpa  # P/VPA = 1

# EV/EBIT alvo (cenários)
ev_ebit_target_5x = 5 * ebit
marketcap_from_ev5 = ev_ebit_target_5x - net_debt
price_from_ev5 = marketcap_from_ev5 / shares

ev_ebit_target_6x = 6 * ebit
marketcap_from_ev6 = ev_ebit_target_6x - net_debt
price_from_ev6 = marketcap_from_ev6 / shares

# Blend (40% P/E ajustado, 30% P/VPA, 30% EV/EBIT 5x)
blend_price = 0.4 * pe_target + 0.3 * pvpa_target + 0.3 * price_from_ev5

market_cap, EV, P_over_L, P_over_VP, EV_over_EBIT, per_share_indemnity, lpa_adj, pe_target, pvpa_target, price_from_ev5, price_from_ev6, blend_price

print('market_cap =', round(market_cap,2))
print('EV =', round(EV,2))
print('P/L =', round(P_over_L,2))
print('P/VP =', round(P_over_VP,2))
print('EV/EBIT =', round(EV_over_EBIT,2))
print('per_share_indemnity =', round(per_share_indemnity,4))
print('LPA ajustado ex-indenizacao =', round(lpa_adj,4))
print('P/E alvo (8x) sobre LPA ajustado =', round(pe_target,2))
print('P/VPA (1x) =', round(pvpa_target,2))
print('Preco implícito EV/EBIT 5x =', round(price_from_ev5,2))
print('Preco implícito EV/EBIT 6x =', round(price_from_ev6,2))
print('Blend (40% P/E adj + 30% P/VPA + 30% EV/EBIT 5x) =', round(blend_price,2))

# Upside to current price
upside_blend = (blend_price - price) / price * 100
print('Upside blend % =', round(upside_blend,2))

# Suggest target rounding
suggested_target = round(max(15.5, min(blend_price, 18.0)),2)
print('Suggested practical target =', suggested_target)"} }
